statement: Secondary-market retail purchase prices for datacenter GPUs (undated 2026 estimates): H100 80GB SXM can cost ~$27,000-$40,000/unit, H200 141GB ~$31,000-$32,000, B200 192GB ~$30,000-$50,000, B300 288GB ~$37,500-$43,750; 8-GPU systems range from ~$216K (H100) to over $500K (B200).
why: Concrete secondary-market hardware buy prices give a confirmation overlay on merchant-GPU hardware value, but the source states no baseline or change, so this is a static level.

impact.mechanism: Physical GPU resale/retail price level is a non-scoring display overlay for merchant-GPU hardware value, not a directional demand or supply signal.

confidence.basis: Single secondary aggregator citing undated 2026 estimates from multiple resellers; no per-day timestamp.

dispersion: Wide per-model ranges across resellers, e.g. H100 ~$27K-$40K and B200 ~$30K-$50K per GPU.
